rules.title: VOEC-grensen gjelder per vare
rules.note: Several eligible items can share a parcel even if its total exceeds NOK 3000. A pack sold as one product requires its own valuation.

rules.title: Norsk mva betales ved kjøp
rules.note: Eligible correctly declared VOEC goods are duty-exempt. Norwegian VAT also applies to shipping/additional costs; verify it appears once in final total.

rules.title: VOEC må meldes elektronisk
rules.note: Seller/carrier must transmit the VOEC identifier digitally. A generic tax-included claim or a printed number alone is insufficient evidence of correct processing.

rules.title: Kontroller registreringen
rules.note: The marketplace may be the registered entity instead of an individual shop. No seller's VOEC status was conclusively verified in this research.

rules.title: Vanlig import
rules.note: For non-VOEC transactions, import VAT and any applicable duty arrive at import, usually with carrier clearance charges. General rate is 25% for these non-food goods.

rules.title: Mva-grunnlag
rules.note: Goods price plus freight, insurance, duty and other taxable charges/commissions. Foreign VAT paid and not removed is part of the goods price. Use customs exchange rate at clearance for import tax, which can differ from card conversion.

rules.title: Tollavgift er ikke et universelt prosentpåslag
rules.note: Tolletaten's consumer page identifies clothes and food as dutiable categories. No SKU-level tariff classification or origin verification was completed for this basket; do not call every line's duty formally verified zero. Cotton yarn is not automatically classified as a finished garment.

rules.title: Fortolling prises per sending
rules.note: Posten tariffs apply only if Posten performs the clearance. Other couriers have their own tariffs. Do not apply one Posten fee across multiple vendor parcels, or append it to confirmed prepaid all-inclusive delivery.

rules.title: Dobbel mva
rules.note: For VOEC purchases charged again at import, seek refund of purchase VAT from the seller and document both payments. Norwegian tax/customs authorities do not correct that seller collection.

Above 3000 NOK, restricted goods or food; certain other declarations

postenFees.boundaryNote: Labels reproduced as bands; at an exact boundary confirm the applicable band with Posten.

sellerSpecific.taxModel: Optional prepaid estimated import duty/VAT at checkout, selected by default
sellerSpecific.note: Norway expressly listed. Keep prepayment selected to use seller's promise of no later import-tax/customs-fee demand. Do not assume this is VOEC, and do not add 25% twice.

formulas.ordinaryImport: B = G + S + I + D + O; VAT = 0.25 × B; delivered = G + S + I + D + O + VAT + C

definitions.G: Goods paid price in NOK; include foreign VAT if seller has not removed/refunded it
definitions.O: Other costs included in VAT base
definitions.C: Carrier clearance charge actually applicable, tax-inclusive where quoted; do not double count in O

formulas.voec: Delivered = confirmed Norway checkout total (goods + freight + Norwegian VAT + any seller charges); no additional carrier fee only if proper electronic VOEC handling.
formulas.prepaid: Delivered = confirmed checkout goods + shipping + prepaid import tax/duty + any explicit fees; no additional VAT added to an already tax-inclusive final total.
formulas.allocation: Calculate tax/fees by consignment first. Allocate freight among rows only as an explicitly stated comparison method.
formulas.ifMissing: If variant, shipping, tax treatment, carrier, FX or stock is unverified, delivered total remains null.
